description: This file defines the SlotsRepository_2024_09_04 class, which manages slot reservations and bookings using Prisma ORM in a NestJS application. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting slot data, as well as checking for overlapping bookings and reservations.

classes.name: SlotsRepository_2024_09_04
classes.description: Repository class for managing slot reservations and bookings, including methods for CRUD operations and overlap checks.

methods.name: getByUid
methods.description: Retrieves a slot by its unique identifier (UID).

methods.name: findActiveOverlappingBooking
methods.description: Finds an active booking that overlaps with a given time range and event type.

methods.name: getOverlappingSlotReservation
methods.description: Checks for existing slot reservations that overlap with a specified time range and are not expired.

methods.name: createSlot
methods.description: Creates a new slot reservation with specified details and a calculated release time.

methods.name: updateSlot
methods.description: Updates an existing slot's start/end times and release time.

methods.name: deleteSlot
methods.description: Deletes slot reservations by UID, using deleteMany due to non-unique UID in schema.
